# Repository Instructions

## General

- Read the minimum number of files required.
- Never scan the whole repository unless explicitly asked.
- Prefer asking one clarification question instead of making assumptions.
- Keep responses concise.
- Explain only when requested.
- Do not repeat previous explanations.

## Editing

- Make the smallest possible change.
- Avoid refactoring unrelated code.
- Preserve existing architecture.
- Do not rename files unless requested.
- Do not rewrite working code.

## Architecture

When discussing architecture:

- reason first
- avoid editing files
- provide a plan before implementation
- wait for approval

## Searching

Before opening many files:

- inspect imports
- inspect exports
- inspect nearby files
- avoid global search unless necessary

## Performance

Minimize token usage by:

- reading only relevant files
- avoiding repeated summaries
- avoiding repeated code generation
- avoiding large explanations

## Code Style

- TypeScript
- Next.js App Router
- Tailwind v4
- shadcn/ui
- Firebase
- Functional React
- Prefer server components
- Strict typing

## Responses

Unless requested:

- no tutorials
- no long explanations
- no code comments
- no markdown tables

Return only what is necessary.
